metrics_method.native_cpu: Process CPU time over the same post-import measured body; not total host CPU or complete interpreter lifetime.
metrics_method.p95: Nearest rank: sorted sample at ceil(0.95*n), one-based; descriptive small-sample statistic, not an SLO certification.
metrics_method.native_overlap: Not measured. Concurrency fields describe client request dispatch, not demonstrated overlap of native processes.
